_about: The site reads this file and claims nothing it does not say. The state below is the one the public repository records (README status and docs/evidence, commit 4da5ffbc); the model's figures are not copied here, so the reconcile block stays empty until the owner records a result himself. The repository and release addresses, and the state words, are also encoded in tools/check_site.py (pl300), which fails if they drift.
project: Power BI project: NYC 311 Service Requests (PL-300 skill areas)
status: dev profile refreshed and reconciled in the Power BI service; full profile, RLS and report pages not yet run
authorship: AI-built, owner-directed: the Power Query, model, measures, RLS and report were written by AI (Claude) from a specification Rashadul directed.
route: It runs in the Power BI service in the browser: Fabric Git integration syncs the project from GitHub into a Premium Per User trial workspace, where the dev profile, a sample of the data, has been refreshed.
method: The numbers are checked against an independent Python twin with the reconcile CLI. On the dev profile every default check matched the twin cell for cell. The full profile has not been refreshed, so no figure from it is claimed.
next_step: Next, on the owner's side: refresh the full profile and reconcile it, test the RLS roles with Test as role, and review the report pages and add real screenshots.
